title: Review V2 requirements and overall design proposal
goal: Independently review TASK-025 proposal against the user scenario, V1 compatibility, and the overall-to-detailed design approval gate
acceptance_criteria: Review checks every actual TASK-025 change and the complete final proposal content
Review verifies scenario fidelity, status precedence, arrival-window semantics, model-first planning, human assignment, acceptance flow, migration safety, desktop-only scope, and the approval gate
Release review records an exact change manifest and content fingerprint in structured evidence

release_controls.execution_window: current V2 overall-design independent review session
release_controls.rollback_plan: remove unrecorded review evidence and return TASK-025 for correction
release_controls.observation_metrics: structured findings, exact change manifest, content fingerprint, and Release governance results
release_controls.stop_conditions: scope mismatch, unapproved detailed design, active baseline mutation, or incomplete evidence
